method: 1980-1982 backward extension of data/fda_original_non_nme_decisions.csv, built verbatim from the committed openFDA Drugs@FDA ORIG/AP payloads (data/raw/openfda_orig_decisions_1980_1984/decisions_{1980,1981,1982}.json, manifest SHA-256 pinned). Identical year-by-year treatment to v15's 1983/1984 pass: FIRST_YEAR=1980, pre-1985 Type 1/1-4 ownership stays with pre1985_fda_decisions.csv (builder aborts on a miss), per-row verbatim payload cross-check in validate_data.py, focus-year audit extended to all six years 1980-1985.

boundary_cases_checked.humulin_1982: BLA018780 (Humulin R, Type 1) and BLA018663 (Chymodiacetin, Type 1) are pre-1985-table rows; only Humulin N BLA018781 (Type 3) is published in the non-NME extension.
boundary_cases_checked.transderm_nitro_1981: NDA020144 (1981-10-19) carries submission_class_code UNKNOWN in the committed payload; published verbatim with FLAGGED: openFDA published no submission_class_code.
boundary_cases_checked.furosemide_trandate_pins: NDA018413/NDA018716 exclusion pins unchanged (1983/1984 rows); no 1980-1982 non-Type-1 application is tracked in the pre-1985 table (verified: non_nme_in_pre1985_table = 0 for all three years).

focus_year_audit.note: per_year values are [total, TRACKED_VERIFIED, TRACKED_REVIEW]; splits pinned in the builder (PINNED_VERDICT_SPLITS) and validator.
focus_year_audit.data_condition_flags: 76 payload rows publish no submission_class_code; 73 publish no review_priority (73 missing both). All flags are documented data conditions, never guesses.

diff_vs_pre_change_snapshot.note: All 2,943 rows of the v15 table (1983-2026) are byte-identical after the v16 rebuild; the v15 pre-1985 note wording is preserved verbatim for the 1983/1984 rows.
diff_vs_pre_change_snapshot.orig_scorecard: 100 issuers (24 ticker rows gained 1980-1982 attributions; 0 removed)

validator: PASS: 0 errors, 1745 warnings (intended manual-review baseline; +64 from the new rows' documented flags)
limitations: openFDA sponsor_name on pre-1985 rows is the CURRENT Drugs@FDA application holder; never asserted as the historical applicant or a period ticker.
FDA publishes no submission class and/or review priority on 76 of the 517 audited payload rows (32 new in 1980-1982); flagged, not guessed.
No independent official contemporaneous annual NME table was located for 1980-1982; the era CSV still labels the Type-1 counts as application-level enumerations.

The 1980 payload's 82 decisions include early IV-solution/medical-gas Type 5 originals (e.g. Abbott/Hospira IV containers, 1980-01-15); they are real FDA decisions but are flagged so they are never scored as biotech clinical-trial conversions.
